wordProblems.q: Max has 9 stickers. Max gives 2 stickers to Mia. How many stickers does Max have left?
Henry has 3 marbles. His friend gives him 2 more marbles. How many marbles does Henry have now?
Emma bakes 8 cookies. She eats 4 of them. How many cookies are left?
There are 9 birds on a tree. 3 birds fly away. How many birds are left on the tree?
Mason has 2 pencils. Mason finds 5 more pencils in a drawer. How many pencils does Mason have now?
Nora has 10 balloons. 5 balloons pop. How many balloons does Nora have left?
Mia has 8 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 2 more books. How many books does Mia have now?
Ben has 9 crayons. He loses 3 crayons at school. How many crayons does Ben have left?
Mia picks 8 oranges from a tree. Then Mia picks 2 more oranges. How many oranges did Mia pick in all?
There are 7 ducks in a pond. 4 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Ella makes 4 cupcakes. Her friend brings 5 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Lucas has 6 toy cars. He gives 4 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Lucas have left?
Layla finds 2 seashells on the beach in the morning and 6 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Layla find in all?
Sophia has 7 flowers in her garden. She picks 6 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
Adam eats 6 grapes at lunch and 4 grapes after school. How many grapes did Adam eat in all?
Noah is reading a book with 10 pages. Noah reads 7 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 8 muffins in the morning and 2 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 7 fish in a tank. The shop sells 2 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Layla has 5 red beads and 5 blue beads. How many beads does Layla have in all?
Owen collects 10 toy trains. He lends 3 trains to a friend. How many trains does Owen have left?
Ella has 7 candies in a jar. She shares 3 candies with her sister. How many candies are left in the jar?
Henry picks 5 lemons from a tree in the morning and 5 lemons in the evening. How many lemons did Henry pick in all?
There are 6 rabbits in a garden. 5 rabbits hop away. How many rabbits are left in the garden?
Ben builds a tower with 4 blocks. Then he adds 5 more blocks on top. How many blocks are in the tower now?
Isabella has 7 buttons in a box. She uses 5 buttons to sew a dress. How many buttons are left in the box?
Henry buys 4 peaches at the market. Then Henry buys 5 more peaches. How many peaches did Henry buy in all?
There are 9 frogs sitting on a log. 2 frogs jump into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Emma collects 4 smooth rocks at the river and 2 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Emma collect in all?
Ava has 7 cherries in a bowl. She gives 4 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
2 red buses and 2 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
